scope: Selected annotation dictionary cells in Tables 180–187 (Square/Circle, Polygon/PolyLine, text markup, Caret, Stamp, Ink, Popup, FileAttachment). Table 188 Sound is outside this pass. This is a bounded assertion review, not a clause certification.

source.locator_method: Opened the primary PDF at the listed physical pages and checked its printed footer and the actual Table heading/Key-Type-Value rows. Pages that contain an introductory cross-reference are not treated as table locations.

source_cells.BS: Optional; line width and dash pattern.
source_cells.IC: Optional; 0/1/3/4 components mean transparent/Gray/RGB/CMYK, components in [0,1].
source_cells.BE: Optional; border effect on BS border.
source_cells.RD: Optional PDF 1.5; [left, top, right, bottom] nonnegative differences from Rect to the actual shape; opposing sums must be less than Rect dimensions.

matrix.assertions: crates/pdf-model/tests/annotations.rs has constructed Square/Circle fill and geometry assertions, with explicit pixels for IC/interior and border. Tests with missing AP are local constructed-appearance policy coverage: Table166 imposes a PDF 2.0 writer AP rule for nondegenerate annotations. Common stored-AP mapping has separate tests in annotations.rs and annotation_appearance_audit.rs. #524 corrects RD's type to array for Table180; existing RD values are four-number arrays.

source_cells.Vertices: Required unless Path exists; if Path exists, Vertices shall be ignored.
source_cells.LE: Optional, meaningful only for PolyLine; two endpoints correspond to first and last path/vertex pair; default None/None.
source_cells.IC: Optional; PolyLine fills applicable line endings; Polygon fills the entire shape.
source_cells.IT/Measure: Optional intent/measure entries; intent names and measurement are covered in the earlier line/polygon shard, not exhaustively here.
source_cells.Path: Optional PDF 2.0 sequence of m/l/c operands; if present Vertices shall not be present; PDF consumer currently accepts coexistence and uses Path.

matrix.assertions: crates/pdf-model/tests/polygon_polyline_spec_audit.rs::polygon_path_strokes_its_closing_edge_while_polyline_path_stays_open, ::polyline_ic_fills_closed_endings_but_not_open_endings, and ::polyline_first_ending_is_at_first_vertex_not_second_vertex use literal raster controls. annotations.rs has Path curve, polygon fill and endpoint cases. EC3 #444 directly changes Table181 so Vertices is ignored with Path; no new issue is raised here.

source_cells.Subtype: Required; one of four markup subtypes.
source_cells.QuadPoints: Required 8*n default-user-space coordinates; each quadrilateral encompasses contiguous underlying text and is ordered counterclockwise relative to text direction.

matrix.assertions: The prior annotations_markup_current shard reviewed QuadPoints and actual markup consumers. viewer-core public test text_markup_popup_spec_audit covers opening a markup's popup from the user interaction path. This pass does not repeat geometry/text-selection certification or claim all four mark styles and writing directions.

source_cells.RD: Optional PDF 1.5 four nonnegative differences; opposing sums less than Rect dimensions. #524 changes the value type to array.
source_cells.Sy: Optional; P associates a paragraph mark with the caret, None associates no symbol; default None. #608 joins the sentence to require the symbol along with the caret.

matrix.assertions: annotations.rs::a_caret_is_reported_whether_or_not_it_asks_for_a_paragraph_symbol checks P/None, four-element RD and reporting. markup_stored_appearance_spec_audit.rs checks distinct stored AP stream colors for Caret and Stamp. The no-AP refusal is owner/product policy; the source gives no exact Caret artwork, and the no-AP test is not a PDF 2.0 producer-valid fixture under Table166.

source_cells.Name: Optional icon name. Writers should include it; readers should provide at least listed standard names; default Draft. If IT is present and is not Stamp, Name shall not be present.

matrix.assertions: annotations.rs checks the no-AP Stamp/product choice and icon selection; file_attachment_icon_audit.rs independently checks its four listed attachment icons, not Stamp. markup_stored_appearance_spec_audit.rs checks supplied Stamp AP. Standard-name recommendation is not treated as a mandatory reader synthesis defect.

source_cells.InkList: Required list of paths in default user space; stroke connects points, but exact joining/interpolation is implementation-dependent.
source_cells.Path: Optional PDF 2.0 m/l/c path operands; EC3 #444 says InkList shall be ignored if Path is present.

matrix.assertions: crates/pdf-model/tests/ink_annotation_spec_audit.rs::an_ink_list_with_three_points_joins_each_consecutive_pair and ::ink_path_six_operands_produce_a_cubic_curve_not_an_endpoint_chord assert selected geometry with literal pixel controls. The latter has a conflicting InkList to discriminate Path priority. It lacks AP and so exercises chosen constructed-appearance behavior rather than a producer-conforming PDF 2.0 rendering obligation. #444 is already durable finding 2038-D12 and is not repeated as a new finding.

source_cells.Parent: Optional, but indirect if present; parent Contents/M/C/T override Popup copies.

matrix.assertions: Primary §12.5.6.14 says Popup has no appearance/actions and is linked through the markup Popup entry. pdf-model/src/popup.rs::the_parents_four_entries_override_the_popups_own checks all four overrides; viewer-core/tests/headless.rs::a_document_that_opens_a_popup_window_says_so_before_anybody_clicks checks public Query::Popups, linkage and visible metadata before interaction. Existing tests cover hidden/visible flags and placement elsewhere.

source_cells.Name: Optional icon; writers should include; readers should provide Graph/PushPin/Paperclip/Tag; default PushPin.
source_cells.Contents versus FS.Desc: The preceding prose requires interactive processors to use annotation Contents rather than optional file-spec Desc.

matrix.assertions: crates/pdf-model/tests/file_attachment_icon_audit.rs::attachment_name_defaults_to_pushpin_and_the_chosen_four_icons_differ and ::attachment_stored_appearance_wins_over_every_icon_name have literal raster controls. viewer-core/tests/file_attachment_annotation_audit.rs exercises clicked FS identity and exact extracted bytes, catalog decoy isolation, plus Contents/Desc precedence and empty-Contents behavior. The reader should-provide icon list is not treated as a hard requirement.

errata.effect: When Path is present, Vertices (Table181) or InkList (Table185) shall be ignored.
errata.status: Table181 and Table185 behaviors are already covered by existing tests. The Table185 annotation was independently visually checked and is already recorded as 2038-D12; no duplicate finding.

errata.effect: RD value type is array, not rectangle.
errata.status: Existing fixtures provide four-number arrays; no reader rejection of a malformed rectangle is inferred.

errata.effect: Connects the sentence so P symbol is displayed along with caret.
errata.status: Existing model handling parses P and retains it with the caret; stored AP has separate coverage.

limits: No new uncovered mandatory reader behavior was established in the selected cells.

No-AP geometry tests for Square/Circle, Polygon/PolyLine, Ink, Stamp, and Caret are policy tests where the PDF 2.0 writer rule requires AP for nondegenerate annotations; they do not certify required stored-AP behavior by themselves.
This pass does not audit all Border Effect variants, every line-ending type, all markup text directions, all popup host platforms, sound, or malformed dictionary recovery.
parent_qualification: Missing AP is allowed in PDF1.7. Do not classify all constructed shape tests as invalid solely because AP is absent: only PDF2.0 cases subject to the writer requirement carry that qualification. Current PDF2 Path tests remain fallback evidence.
